title: game/data/battleAnims.json: how the battle plays a move, as data (VFX-8; logic/battle-anims.js, battle-anim-run.js)

bigPower.description: a move of this power or more passes the power80 gate (a handheld wobble, the camera sweep)

longPower.description: a move of this power or more (and a signature scene) may run extraMs longer than its default family

extraMs.description: the most a long move or a scene may add (none under Reduced motion), stage ms

shortSpeed.description: at this battle speed or more a family's short variant plays

maxMs.description: the longest a move may play, stage ms, by outcome and category (the times before VFX-8); a long move or a scene adds at most extraMs

flashes.description: the full-screen flash limiter (WCAG 2.3.1): at most perSecond in any second, gapMs apart, none whose red share R/(R+G+B) is redShare or more; a flash held back becomes a sprite flash

budgets.description: VFX-9's budgets, by the battle's quality 0-3 (VFX-12 made them data): particles alive in the one pool (ambient ones at most a quarter), a burst's most, effect lights (3 slots: keys 8-10), at most lightsPhone on a phone and lightsAll battle lights in all (the scars' cap is VFX-15's scars.cap)

smears.description: Part 1's dials (VFX-1..VFX-5; logic/smear.js smearDialsSet, VFX-12): the afterimages, the ribbon, a dash's ribbon, the stretch, a lunge's lean

cells.description: the kept places it runs along (24 a second)

half.description: half width at its head, metres

twist.description: share of a spinning throw's tumble it twists by

core.description: the white core's share of its width

fray.description: how much of its tail erodes in flight

steps.description: erosion steps once the object stops (one a 24 fps cell)

half.description: half width as a share of the Billie's height

pace.description: a cell stretches at this times the throw's mean speed or more

k.description: share of the way back to the place a cell ago
lean per stage px a ms of sideways speed

max.description: at most (the top's shift per metre of height)

back.description: share of the lean moving back home

colors.description: named colours steps use (or `type`: the move type's)

defaults.description: the family for each outcome and category when a move names none

scenes.description: signature scenes by id (VFX-17); a family's shape

sprites.description: VFX-10: the effect strips by id: game/art/battle/anims/<id>.png, frames side by side in 8 greys (tools/build-battle-anims.py --check holds the strips to this)

cell.description: one frame's width and height, px

frames.description: frames in the strip (3-8 for an effect; a mark on the ground may have 1)

anchor.description: the px, from the top left, that sits on the effect's place

fps.description: frames a second (12 when left out)

impact.description: its first two frames play at 24 fps

loop.description: plays round while it lives (else once, ending with its life)

ground.description: a mark on the ground at 32 px/m (VFX-15's scars); else a texel is a stage pixel at its depth

ramps.description: VFX-10: what colours a sprite, by id (a type id, None, Bureau, up, down, heal): grey index i is the ramp's step i (0-6), 7 stays white

ramp.description: an NW_PALETTE ramp (game/art/next/palette.js) or 8 hexes, darkest first

light.description: the colour it lights the stage with: a hex, or type (the type's glow, types.json)

iconSprites.description: VFX-10: the icons.png particles the stage draws with a strip instead, like for like (sprite), and the ramp an untyped one takes

glow.description: how much brighter in its own colours

byQuality.description: one number for each of the battle's quality levels 0-3 (0 the best)

dur.description: stage ms until the line may move on

hit.description: stage ms when the plates repaint (999: no hit)

at.description: stage ms after the move starts (missing: at once)
